name: Miton
decision_note: Prague private investment group that invests its partners' own money ('Investujeme vlastní peníze') in and co-builds pre-seed/seed startups (e.g. ACE, Oct 2026) - a real, active investor but not a pooled VC fund, so outside the VC pilot.

evidence.quote: S Jirkou Diblíkem se proto dohodli, že se Miton stane rovnocenným partnerem a na začátek investuje řádově miliony korun.
S řadou portfoliových firem jsme byli už ve fázi formování produktu či hledání product-market-fit.

analyst_notes: Type: Miton describes investing its own money ('Investujeme vlastní peníze.' - no classic fund cycle), often as co-founder/equal partner (ACE: Miton becomes an equal partner and invests 'řádově miliony korun', 2026-10-01 press release on its blog), so it is typed private_investor (venture-builder style) and excluded from the VC pilot with S1. It also runs thematic vehicles (MITON C - web3 'fund', Miton Psychonauts - mental health) whose external-LP status is unknown; if those take outside capital, a reviewer might re-type Miton as vc. Stage: the site's 'Kdy a kolik investujeme' block lists Pre-seed and Seed. Sector list on the homepage: AI/augmented workforce, crypto/web3, e-commerce, gastrotech, psychedelics/mental health (mapped to ai_data, ecommerce_marketplaces, healthtech; crypto and gastrotech have no exact code). Homepage says portfolio value EUR 450m across 61 companies built (not used as capital - it is portfolio value). Legal: the group uses many MITON-named SPVs at Křižíkova 148/34, Praha 8; MITON CZ, s.r.o. (founded 2000 per the site timeline) and MITON INVESTMENT, a.s. listed as holdings.
